features.name: health_risk_score
features.description: Ordinal mapping of health status from recommended (0) to not recommended (2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure for health risk, allowing the linear SVM to learn a monotonic relationship and optimize margin.

features.name: social_problem_score
features.description: Ordinal mapping of social conditions from non-problematic (0) to problematic (2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth linear projection of social difficulties, improving margin generalization compared to one-hot encoding.

features.name: housing_finance_burden
features.description: Composite score adding housing criticality and financial inconvenience.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two related socioeconomic factors into a single continuous feature, reducing dimensionality and aiding linear separation.

features.name: children_count_num
features.description: Numeric conversion of the children category, mapping 'more' to 4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a categorical variable into a continuous numeric feature, enabling the model to capture the linear effect of family size.

features.name: nursing_criticality
features.description: Ordinal scale of nursing needs from proper (0) to very critical (4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a graded severity measure of nursing requirements, which is highly suitable for linear margin optimization.

features.name: family_structure_complexity
features.description: Semantic assessment of family complexity based on parents' status, number of children, and family form.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear interactions between family structure variables, projecting them into a single continuous dimension for the SVM.

features.name: socioeconomic_disadvantage_index
features.description: Holistic evaluation of socioeconomic disadvantage combining housing, finance, and social factors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a weighted composite of socioeconomic status, offering a smoother decision boundary for the linear model.

features.name: overall_vulnerability_score
features.description: Sum of health risk, social problem, and nursing criticality scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a strong linear projection of overall vulnerability, directly supporting the SVM's ability to separate high-risk cases.
features.formula: np.where(health == 'not_recom', 2.0, np.where(health == 'priority', 1.0, 0.0)) + np.where(social == 'problematic', 2.0, np.where(social == 'slightly_prob', 1.0, 0.0)) + np.where(has_nurs == 'very_crit', 2.0, np.where(has_nurs == 'critical', 1.5, np.where(has_nurs == 'improper', 1.0, 0.0)))

features.name: is_foster_or_incomplete
features.description: Binary indicator for non-standard family forms (foster or incomplete).
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates specific structural family risks into a clear binary feature, providing a distinct hyperplane split.

features.name: parents_pretentiousness
features.description: Ordinal mapping of parents' pretentiousness from usual (0) to great_pret (2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical parental attitudes into an ordinal scale, allowing the model to assign a proportional weight.

features.name: high_needs_indicator
features.description: Binary flag indicating if any of the critical needs (health, nursing, housing) are at their highest risk level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a sharp, non-linear threshold feature that the linear SVM can use to immediately flag extreme cases.

features.name: resource_to_needs_ratio
features.description: Semantic estimation of the ratio between available resources (finance, housing) and family needs (children, health).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a ratio-based feature, which is often difficult for linear models to learn directly from raw inputs, improving the feature space.
